metadataProvenance.mode_uid_gid_names: Original TAR headers read by Python tarfile; enriched original 4924-row tar-inventory.tsv with UID/GID/uname/gname.
metadataProvenance.mtime: Original TAR Unix epoch, rendered as UTC ISO8601; no extracted Windows timestamp used.
unavailable: TAR has no per-member CRC32, inode, link count or independent packed size.
No btime/atime in these TAR headers.

provenance.unknownPolicy: Blank means not supplied by the original format/listing or not previously measured, never zero.
provenance.pathPolicy: Archive member paths retained as relative paths; Windows display separators normalized to /. No extraction filesystem metadata used.

serialization: UTF-8 CSV, LF record separators; original parsed field values preserved
